claims: John Sauer is the 49th Solicitor General of the United States.
John Sauer is the current Solicitor General of the United States.
John Sauer assumed the position of Solicitor General of the United States in April 2025.
The Solicitor General of the United States acts as the federal government's lead litigator before the U.S. Supreme Court.
The Solicitor General of the United States is often referred to as the "tenth justice".
The Solicitor General of the United States is responsible for conducting and supervising all Supreme Court cases on behalf of the U.S. government.
The Solicitor General of the United States determines which cases the federal government will appeal to the Supreme Court.
The Solicitor General of the United States decides when the government will intervene or file amicus curiae briefs in cases.
The Solicitor General of the United States argues cases on behalf of the Executive Branch before the Supreme Court.
The Solicitor General of the United States is based in the Department of Justice.
The Solicitor General's office is part of the Department of Justice.
The Solicitor General's office is based in Washington, D.C.
Elizabeth B. Prelogar served as the 48th Solicitor General from 2021 to 2025
